* COMMISSIONER MEETING NOTICE* ​
The Board of Commissioner's regular meeting will be on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 7:30 A.M in the Commissioner's Room at the Courthouse. The Morrill County Board of Equalization will meet on
Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 7:45 A.M. The Agenda for such meeting is kept continuously current
and is available for public inspection at the office of the County Clerk during normal business hours.
Archived Agendas & Minutes are available to view on the Commissioner's page.
